natural_statement: This auxiliary replay asserts only the six even algebra statements in FamilyOrbitLocalization, not review completeness or geometry. For every commutative ring A, x in A and N in Nat (including zero), (1-x)*sum_{0<=j<N} x^j = 1-x^N. Define R(u,nu,N) = u*sum_{0<=j<N} (-nu*u)^j. For every commutative ring A, t,u,nu in A and N in Nat with t*u=1 and nu^N=0, (t+nu)*R(u,nu,N)=1; for every v in A with (t+nu)*v=1, v=R(u,nu,N). For every commutative scalar ring K, K-modules V,W,U with additive commutative group structures, finite type J, linear P:V->W and L:W->U, c:J->K and h:J->V, L(sum_j c(j) smul P(h(j))) = sum_j c(j) smul (L compose P)(h(j)). For the same modules and finite J, every linear L:W->U, family of linear D(j):V->W and h:J->V satisfies L(sum_j D(j)(h(j))) = sum_j (L compose D(j))(h(j)). For every commutative K, finite type I with decidable equality, K-modules V_i,W with additive commutative group structures, finite types J_i, multilinear F:(product_i V_i)->W, scalar families c_i:J_i->K and vectors h_i:J_i->V_i, F(i |-> sum_j c_i(j) smul h_i(j)) equals sum_{choice:product_i J_i} (product_i c_i(choice_i)) smul F(i |-> h_i(choice_i)). Empty finite types are included. No nontriviality, characteristic-zero, geometric nilpotence, super-sign, moduli, virtual-class, S/R-factorization or quantization claim is made.
scope: A faithful reproduction, never mechanical evidence for C_REVIEW.
